style.name: Ember After Dark
style.line: tapered luminous brush lines on black masses
style.palette: aubergine, soot, electric turquoise, ember orange
style.shading: hard cel shadows with concentrated painted glow
style.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital dark-fantasy ink with tapered luminous brush contours over deep aubergine and soot masses. Electric turquoise water and ember-orange fire are small concentrated painted light sources; stone has muted mauve planes, and pale bone highlights reveal the silhouettes. Use hard cel-shadow shapes and spare scratch marks, with isolated brush-glow edges rather than broad bloom. Sparse islands of detail float against quiet darkness, giving a charged occult and rebellious mood. The camp remains magically suppressed, lit only by ordinary lamps and painted rim light. No neon signage, science fiction or three-dimensional rendering.

input.prompt:
STYLE: Hand-drawn digital dark-fantasy ink with tapered luminous brush contours over deep aubergine and soot masses. Electric turquoise water and ember-orange fire are small concentrated painted light sources; stone has muted mauve planes, and pale bone highlights reveal the silhouettes. Use hard cel-shadow shapes and spare scratch marks, with isolated brush-glow edges rather than broad bloom. Sparse islands of detail float against quiet darkness, giving a charged occult and rebellious mood. The camp remains magically suppressed, lit only by ordinary lamps and painted rim light. No neon signage, science fiction or three-dimensional rendering.

ACTION: Draw an overhead tactical action-RPG fight on a broad sandy Roman arena floor, with small foreshortened combatants seen from above, open paths between them, and a thin rim of stone wall at the screen edges. At lower centre a Water mage faces straight UP the screen with both hands reaching toward enemies: immediately ABOVE her head is an inverted-U cyan magical shield arc, opening DOWN toward her, protecting her front while the sand BELOW and BEHIND her is completely bare. An orange fireball from the enemy mage at upper right bursts into a compact white spark on the TOP edge of this cyan shield arc; separately, a thin cyan needle from the player's outstretched hand travels diagonally toward a shield-bearing soldier at upper left. A slinger farther left and a cinder hound to the right create spaced threats, with a small jagged red-and-black warning patch off to the right; each fighter is small within the broad overhead floor, and every effect has its own clearly readable path. All figures, spell marks and terrain are hand-painted parts of this single game-view illustration; leave quiet strips along the top and bottom for later interface labels.

CONSTRAINTS: An original Roman-era elemental-mage prison game, drawn digitally by hand as a complete two-dimensional illustration. Roman-inspired tunics, sandals, limewashed masonry, terracotta, bronze collars and ward stones; invented people and symbols only. Entire scene in focus, clear silhouettes, readable at a reduced game-screen scale. No three-dimensional rendering, photography, modern equipment, existing franchise designs, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, panel grid or decorative outer frame.
